title: perf trampoline reports wrong code size to profiler
author: Tony123-tech
body_preview: ### Bug description  The perf trampoline writes an entry to `/tmp/perf-<pid>.map` for every compiled trampoline. The size field in that entry is the raw size of the assembly template (`perf_code_arena->code_size`), not the aligned chunk size that the arena actually advances by. title: Run the Python test suite in parallel by default
author: vstinner
body_preview: Currently, `python -m test` runs tests sequentially in a single process by default.
